route: Srinagar (2N) - Gulmarg (1N) - Pahalgam (1N) - Dal Lake Houseboat (1N)
description: The definitive Kashmir dream vacation. Cruise through water-lilies on Dal Lake in a wooden Shikara, ride the high-altitude Gulmarg Gondola over pine trees, picnic along the roaring Lidder river in Pahalgam, and sleep under stars on a heritage wooden houseboat.
hotelStay: 4★ Lake View Hotels & 1 Night Luxury Houseboat

itinerary.title: Arrival in Srinagar & Dal Lake Sunset Shikara
itinerary.details: Warm Kashmiri welcome at Srinagar Airport. Check-in at hotel. Evening 1-hour sunset Shikara ride across Dal Lake, visiting floating gardens and Nehru Park.

itinerary.title: Srinagar to Gulmarg Day Trip (Gondola Cable Car)
itinerary.details: Drive to the "Meadow of Flowers" Gulmarg. Ascend to Phase 1 (Kongdoori) & Phase 2 (Apharwat Peak 13,780 ft) via the famous Gondola cable car. Return to Srinagar.

itinerary.title: Srinagar to Pahalgam via Saffron Fields of Pampore
itinerary.details: Scenic mountain drive past world-famous Pampore saffron fields and Awantipora ruins. Check-in at riverside resort in Pahalgam. Walk along the crystal Lidder river.

itinerary.title: Pahalgam Betaab Valley, Aru & Chandanwari
itinerary.details: Full day excursion to picturesque Betaab Valley, Aru alpine meadows, and Chandanwari (start point of holy Amarnath Yatra). Evening local wool shopping.

itinerary.title: Pahalgam to Srinagar Heritage Houseboat Stay
itinerary.details: Drive back to Srinagar. Check-in to a luxury carved cedar-wood Houseboat on Nigeen / Dal Lake. Visit Shalimar Bagh and Nishat Bagh royal Mughal gardens.

itinerary.title: Departure with Sweet Mountain Memories
itinerary.details: Morning breakfast overlooking the lake. Transfer to Srinagar airport with authentic Kashmiri dry fruits and shawls memories.

included: All State Tolls, Parking & Driver Charges
excluded: Gulmarg Gondola tickets (booked directly via JK Tourism)

route: Jaipur (2N) - Pushkar & Ajmer (1N) - Udaipur (2N)
description: Step into royal Rajput history. Explore towering stone ramparts of Amber Fort, photograph pink Hawa Mahal, visit holy Brahma Temple in sacred Pushkar, and cruise the golden waters of Lake Pichola in romantic Udaipur.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Jaipur & Chokhi Dhani Cultural Village
itinerary.details: Arrival at Jaipur. Check-in at heritage haveli. Evening visit to Chokhi Dhani ethnic village resort for authentic Rajasthani folk dance, puppet show, and royal thali dinner.

itinerary.title: Jaipur Forts & Palaces (Amber, Hawa Mahal & Nahargarh)
itinerary.details: Morning visit to grand Amber Fort. Photo stop at Jal Mahal in Man Sagar Lake. Afternoon tour of City Palace, Jantar Mantar observatory, and sunset at Nahargarh Fort.

itinerary.title: Jaipur to Pushkar via Ajmer Sharif Dargah
itinerary.details: Drive to holy Pushkar. Visit world-famous Ajmer Sharif Dargah en route. Attend peaceful evening aarti at Pushkar holy lake and visit the unique Lord Brahma temple.

itinerary.title: Pushkar to Udaipur (City of Lakes)
itinerary.details: Scenic highway drive to Udaipur. Check-in at lake-facing hotel. Evening leisurely stroll around Fateh Sagar Lake and Saheliyon Ki Bari royal maiden gardens.

itinerary.title: Udaipur City Palace & Sunset Lake Pichola Boat Cruise
itinerary.details: Visit grand City Palace museum. Afternoon boat ride on shimmering Lake Pichola to Jag Mandir palace. Evening cultural dance show at historic Bagore Ki Haveli.

itinerary.title: Departure from Udaipur
itinerary.details: Morning souvenir shopping for Bandhani sarees and handicrafts in old city bazaars. Drop-off at Udaipur airport or railway station.

route: Cochin - Munnar (2N) - Thekkady (1N) - Alleppey Backwaters (1N) - Cochin

itinerary.title: Cochin to Munnar (Waterfalls & Tea Hills Drive)

itinerary.title: Munnar Tea Estates, Eravikulam & Mattupetty Dam
itinerary.details: Visit Eravikulam National Park (home to endangered Nilgiri Tahr). Tour KDHP Tea Museum, Mattupetty Lake Dam boating, and the natural Echo Point.

itinerary.title: Munnar to Thekkady (Periyar Tiger Reserve)
itinerary.details: Drive through cardamom hills to Thekkady. Enjoy guided spice plantation tour and evening Kalaripayattu martial arts and Kathakali cultural show.

itinerary.title: Thekkady to Alleppey (Private Houseboat Cruise)
itinerary.details: Drive to Alleppey backwaters. Board your private traditional thatched Houseboat at 12:30 PM. Cruise through palm-fringed lagoons, paddy fields, and backwater villages.

itinerary.title: Houseboat Check-out & Drop at Cochin Airport
itinerary.details: Enjoy morning sunrise over backwaters with traditional Kerala breakfast. Disembark at 9:30 AM and transfer to Cochin airport or railway station.

route: Bagdogra / NJP - Gangtok (4N) - Tsomgo Lake & Baba Mandir - Bagdogra
description: Discover the untamed grandeur of the Eastern Himalayas. Behold Mount Kanchenjunga, visit sacred glacial lake Tsomgo at 12,310 feet, explore 300-year-old Buddhist monasteries, and enjoy vibrant MG Marg evenings.

itinerary.title: Bagdogra/NJP to Gangtok (Scenic Teesta River Drive)
itinerary.details: Pickup from Bagdogra/NJP. Breathtaking 4.5-hour drive alongside the roaring emerald Teesta river. Check-in at hotel. Evening stroll at pedestrian-only MG Marg.

itinerary.title: Excursion to Sacred Tsomgo Lake & Baba Mandir
itinerary.details: Drive to high-altitude holy Tsomgo Lake (12,310 ft) with snowy peaks reflecting in water. Visit historic Baba Harbhajan Singh shrine near Indo-China border.

itinerary.title: Gangtok Full Day Sightseeing (Monasteries & Waterfalls)
itinerary.details: Visit Rumtek Monastery (Seat of Karmapa), Banjhakri Waterfalls, Do Drul Chorten Stupa, Namgyal Institute of Tibetology, and panoramic Tashi Viewpoint.

itinerary.title: Day Excursion to Namchi & Chardham Complex
itinerary.details: Scenic day tour to Namchi. Visit the colossal 108-ft statue of Lord Shiva at Siddheshwar Dham and 135-ft Guru Padmasambhava statue atop Samdruptse hill.

itinerary.title: Departure to Bagdogra / NJP
itinerary.details: After breakfast, drive down through scenic pine hills back to Bagdogra Airport or NJP Railway Station with unforgettable memories of Sikkim.

itinerary.details: Leisurely morning swim in the sea and breakfast. Souvenir shopping at local flea markets. Drop-off at airport or railway station.

route: Ayodhya (2N) - Prayagraj Sangam - Varanasi / Kashi (2N)
description: The holy pilgrimage of a lifetime. Experience VIP Darshan at the grand Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Mandir in Ayodhya, evening Saryu Maha Aarti, Holy Triveni Sangam Snan in Prayagraj, and the divine Kashi Vishwanath Corridor with Dashashwamedh Ganga Aarti boat seats.
transport: Private AC Sedan / Innova with Local Pilot

itinerary.title: Arrival in Ayodhya & Saryu Maha Aarti
itinerary.details: Warm traditional welcome on arrival at Ayodhya. Check-in at hotel. Afternoon visit to Ram Ki Paidi and attend the divine Saryu Maha Aarti with hundreds of glowing lamps. Evening visit to Hanuman Garhi temple.

itinerary.title: Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Mandir VIP Darshan & Kanak Bhawan
itinerary.details: Morning peaceful darshan at the magnificent Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra. Visit Sita Rasoi, Kanak Bhawan, Dashrath Mahal, and the Surya Kund heritage light show in the evening.

itinerary.title: Ayodhya to Prayagraj Sangam to Varanasi (Kashi)
itinerary.details: Scenic drive to Prayagraj. Sacred holy bath (snan) and boat ride at Triveni Sangam (Ganga, Yamuna, Saraswati). Visit Anand Bhawan and Bade Hanuman temple. Continue drive to holy Kashi (Varanasi). Night stay in Varanasi.

itinerary.title: Kashi Vishwanath Jyotirlinga & Evening Ganga Aarti
itinerary.details: Early morning VIP Darshan at Kashi Vishwanath temple via the grand corridor. Visit Annapurna Mandir and Kaal Bhairav. Sunset boat ride on river Ganga to witness the mesmerizing world-famous Maha Aarti at Dashashwamedh Ghat.

itinerary.title: Sarnath Buddhist Stupa & Departure
itinerary.details: Morning trip to peaceful Sarnath where Lord Buddha gave his first sermon. Explore Dhamek Stupa and archaeological museum. Drop-off at Varanasi airport or railway station with divine prasad.

itinerary.title: Delhi/Chandigarh to Shimla (Scenic Drive & Mall Road)
itinerary.details: Pickup from Delhi/Chandigarh in private air-conditioned cab. Drive up the Shivalik hills with stop at Timber Trail. Evening check-in at Shimla mountain-view hotel. Stroll along the famous Mall Road, Ridge, and Christ Church.

itinerary.title: Shimla & Kufri Sightseeing (Snow World & Jakhoo)
itinerary.details: After hearty breakfast, drive to Kufri. Enjoy horse riding to Mahasu Peak, Himalayan Nature Park, and adventure activities. Afternoon visit to sacred Jakhoo Temple via ropeway and Viceregal Lodge heritage gardens.

itinerary.title: Shimla to Manali via Sundernagar Lake, Pandoh Dam & Kullu
itinerary.details: Breathtaking 8-hour drive alongside the roaring Beas river. Photo stops at Sundernagar Lake, Pandoh Dam, and Hanogi Mata temple. Stop at Kullu for river rafting and authentic Shawl factory shopping. Night stay in Manali.

itinerary.title: Solang Valley Adventure & Atal Tunnel to Sissu (Lahaul)
itinerary.details: Early morning excursion to Solang Valley. Thrilling paragliding, zorbing, and quad biking. Drive through the historic 9.02 km Atal Tunnel to enter Lahaul Valley and witness the magnificent Sissu Waterfall.

itinerary.title: Manali Local Heritage & Cafés (Hadimba, Vashisht & Old Manali)
itinerary.details: Visit 500-year-old Hadimba Devi Temple amidst towering deodars, Manu Temple, hot sulphur springs at Vashisht, Tibetan Monastery, and spend the evening enjoying live music & trout fish in Old Manali cafés.

itinerary.title: Manali to Delhi/Chandigarh Departure with Cherished Memories
itinerary.details: After breakfast, checkout and drive back towards Chandigarh/Delhi. Dropped at airport or railway station with lifetime Himalayan memories.

route: Shimla - Sangla - Kalpa - Nako - Tabo - Kaza (2N) - Chandratal - Manali
description: The definitive Himalayan trans-Himalayan overland adventure. Travel the legendary Hindustan-Tibet road through Kinnaur, enter the cold desert of Spiti, visit 1000-year-old monasteries, send postcards from highest post office, and camp by Chandratal lake.

itinerary.details: Visit 500-year-old preserved monk mummy at Gue, Nako sacred lake, and 1000-year-old Tabo UNESCO Monastery.

itinerary.details: Visit iconic Key Monastery, cross Asia’s highest Chicham bridge, mail a postcard at Hikkim, and visit highest motorable village Komik.

itinerary.title: Kaza to Chandratal (The Moon Lake) via Kunzum Pass
itinerary.details: Cross majestic Kunzum La (4,590m). Hike to turquoise Chandratal lake. Camp under Milky Way galaxy.

itinerary.title: Chandratal to Manali via Batal & Rohtang/Atal Tunnel
itinerary.details: Conquer the raw river crossings of Batal and Chhatru. Cross Atal Tunnel to arrive in Manali.

itinerary.title: Manali to Chandigarh Drop
itinerary.details: Farewell Himalayan drive back to Chandigarh airport/station.

itinerary.title: Double Decker Living Root Bridge Trek at Nongriat
itinerary.details: Trek down into the rainforest valley to marvel at the bio-engineered Double Decker Root Bridge and natural turquoise rock pools.

itinerary.title: Cherrapunji to Dawki & Mawlynnong (Cleanest Village)
itinerary.details: Drive to Indo-Bangladesh border. Take a wooden boat ride on transparent Umngot River where boats float in air. Tour Mawlynnong Asia’s cleanest village.

itinerary.title: Dawki to Guwahati Drop via Krang Shuri Falls
itinerary.details: Morning swim at Krang Shuri turquoise falls. Drive back to Guwahati airport/station.

included: Dedicated Private Cab with Local Driver Guide
All Tolls, Parking & Forest Entry Permits

pickup: Sri Guru Ram Dass Jee Airport / Amritsar Junction
route: Amritsar Airport/Station - Sri Harmandir Sahib (2N) - Wagah Border - Amritsar
description: Immerse in the peace and grandeur of Sri Harmandir Sahib (The Golden Temple) illuminated over the holy Amrit Sarovar pool. Experience the world’s largest free community kitchen (Langar), witness the patriotic Wagah Border Beating Retreat ceremony, and savor authentic Punjabi cuisine.
hotelStay: 4★ Hotel Walking Distance from Golden Temple
meals: Daily Breakfast & Amritsari Kulcha / Langar Experience

itinerary.title: Arrival in Amritsar & Night Golden Temple Darshan
itinerary.details: Pickup and check-in. Evening visit to Sri Harmandir Sahib bathed in golden light reflecting in the holy Sarovar. Participate in Langar service.

itinerary.title: Jallianwala Bagh & Wagah Border Retreat Ceremony
itinerary.details: Morning heritage walk to historic Jallianwala Bagh. Afternoon drive to Indo-Pak Wagah Border for the thrilling military Beating Retreat ceremony.

itinerary.title: Partition Museum & Departure
itinerary.details: Visit Partition Museum and taste authentic Amritsari stuffed kulchas and sweet lassi. Drop-off at airport or station.

included: Dedicated Private AC Cab for all transfers

route: Dehradun - Kanatal (1N) - Chopta (2N) - Chakrata (1N) - Dehradun
description: Escape tourist crowds and immerse into pristine deodar forests, alpine bugyal meadows, and crystal clear night skies. Hike to the world’s highest Shiva temple at Tungnath, stargaze in Swiss tents at Chopta, and discover the hidden waterfalls of Chakrata.

itinerary.title: Arrival Dehradun to Kanatal Pine Ridge
itinerary.details: Scenic ascent past Mussoorie bypass to quiet Kanatal. Check into wooden mountain chalet overlooking snow peaks. Sunset forest walk.

itinerary.title: Kanatal to Chopta (Mini Switzerland of India)
itinerary.details: Drive along Mandakini river gorge into dense rhododendron forests of Chopta. Evening bonfire and stargazing under pollution-free skies.

itinerary.title: Tungnath Shiva Temple & Chandrashila Peak Trek
itinerary.details: Hike 4.5 km to the highest Shiva temple on Earth at Tungnath (3,680m) and climb Chandrashila summit for 360-degree Himalayan views.

itinerary.title: Chopta to Hidden Chakrata & Tiger Falls
itinerary.details: Drive to the unspoiled British cantonment hamlet of Chakrata. Trek down to pristine Tiger Falls and walk through centuries-old oak and deodar woods.

itinerary.title: Chakrata to Dehradun Departure
itinerary.details: Morning stroll to Chilmiri sunset point. Descend smoothly back to Dehradun airport or railway station.

route: Rishikesh - Shivpuri Camp (2N) - Triveni Ghat - Haridwar
description: Feel the thunder of holy River Ganga with Grade III/IV white-water rafting, body surfing, cliff jumping, evening beach campfire with live guitar music, and divine sunset Ganga Aarti at Triveni Ghat.
hotelStay: Riverside Luxury Swiss Camps with Pool
meals: All Meals Included (Buffet Breakfast, Lunch, Evening Snacks & Dinner with Bonfire)

itinerary.title: Arrival in Rishikesh & Riverside Camp Check-in
itinerary.details: Check-in at luxury swiss camps along the Ganga tributary. Evening volleyball, river dip, beach campfire with barbecue snacks and music.

itinerary.title: 16 Km White Water Rafting & Cliff Jump
itinerary.details: Conquer famous rapids: Roller Coaster, Golf Course, and Club House. Experience 25-ft cliff jumping and body surfing under certified instructors.

itinerary.title: Beatles Ashram, Triveni Ghat Aarti & Departure
itinerary.details: Visit iconic Beatles Ashram graffiti huts, attend sunset Maha Aarti at Triveni Ghat, and drop-off at Haridwar or Dehradun station.

included: 16 Km River Rafting with all gear & guide

route: Varanasi (2N) - Prayagraj Sangam Day Trip - Sarnath (1N) - Varanasi
description: Experience the eternal spirituality of Kashi Vishwanath Dham, private evening boat ride during grand Dashashwamedh Ganga Aarti, holy Triveni Sangam bath in Prayagraj, and the tranquil Buddhist deer park at Sarnath.
meals: Daily Breakfast & Authentic Banarasi Food Experience

itinerary.title: Arrival in Varanasi & Evening Ganga Maha Aarti
itinerary.details: Warm pickup and hotel check-in. Evening private traditional bajra boat cruise to witness the divine Maha Aarti at Dashashwamedh Ghat from the water.

itinerary.title: Kashi Vishwanath Corridor & Subah-e-Banaras
itinerary.details: Sunrise boat ride along 84 Ghats. VIP darshan at Sri Kashi Vishwanath Golden Temple, Annapurna Mandir, and stroll through ancient alleyways.

itinerary.title: Excursion to Prayagraj Triveni Sangam
itinerary.details: Day trip to Prayagraj. Sacred mid-river boat ride at the confluence of Ganga, Yamuna & Saraswati. Visit Bade Hanuman Mandir and Anand Bhawan.

itinerary.title: Sarnath Buddhist Stupas & Departure
itinerary.details: Visit Dhamek Stupa and Ashoka Pillar where Lord Buddha delivered his first sermon. Transfer to Varanasi airport or station.

included: Dedicated AC Cab for all days including Prayagraj excursion
Private Sunset & Sunrise Boat Rides on Ganga
All Tolls, Parking & Driver Night Charges
